title: Grant #16 HOOK-A (hook-1..hook-2) - map agent hook, round 3
note: STYLE_LOCK 1a + 1c + 2b: clean first frame, nothing before it is spoken, one big card at a time, ONE continuous zoom, visible fire only
frames: frame 0: the theatre, Feb 1862, territory, both flags, boats + columns already moving
'two rivers': the Tennessee + Cumberland light up from the Ohio
'open doors': blue arrows up both rivers, OPEN DOORS
'two forts': the forts slam onto the rivers
'held them shut': red bars across both rivers, HELD SHUT
ONE continuous zoom (no cut, no flash)
mid-zoom: the henry map, CUMBERLAND RIVER on its words
the donelson map fades in, the Union corridor colours in
lands on 'Fort Donelson': FORT DONELSON, the garrison
'within a week': blue columns march over from Fort Henry, legend
CONFEDERATE SOLDIERS lights on its words, the ring front
SURRENDERED: the pocket turns blue, garrison greys, white flag
'almost nobody...heard of': badge pulse, the ring on the HQ
FIRST MAJOR VICTORY / OF THE WAR
'it began as...': camera pushes in on the Union right
A DISASTER, red pulse (hook-b starts on this camera)
